name: track-cc
title: Control mode follows selected track
pitch: In Control mode the five knobs send their CCs on the MIDI channel of the track you came from, so they reach the synth that track plays. Knobs set to Global follow the track; knobs set to 1..16 keep their fixed channel. Each pattern remembers where you left those knobs: when the pattern's sound is loaded again (a pattern switch or a Program Change) your tweaks are sent right after it, and Save Project keeps them.
description: In Control mode, knobs on the Global channel send on the MIDI channel of the track Control mode was entered from; what they send is kept per pattern, resent after each Program Change or switch to that pattern, and saved with the project
